rows.note: This is the all-purpose pattern for an item or items that remain after others have been removed.

example.english: Leave the remaining rice for me after you've finished the dishes.
example.traditional: 食完啲餸，剩低嘅飯留畀我啦。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 di1 sung3 sing6 dai1 ge3 faan6 lau4 bei2 ngo5 laa1

rows.note: Use this when stressing that this is the only item or set of items left, as in the only remaining cake.

example.english: The only remaining cake in the fridge is mine, so don't eat it.
example.traditional: 雪櫃入面淨返嗰個蛋糕係我嘅，唔好食呀。
example.jyutping: syut3 gwai6 jap6 min6 zing6 faan1 go2 go3 daan6 gou1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 m4 hou2 sik6 aa3
